_about: Numbers measured on the user's own Episode 1 recording (the real Indio voice, videos/ep01-ang-unang-talon). Sentence ids are indexes into baseline/real_ep1.json, i.e. the sentences of ep01 script_elevenlabs.txt in order (42). A new reference recording needs a new profile: re-measure every field as its note says.

_notes.prompts: tone -> real sentence ids used as the continuation prompt in mode U (the LAST id sets the tone). Chosen by hand on 2026-11-12 from real sentences read in that tone (baseline rows: clean words, clean end); for a new recording re-pick by tone tag and by ear. 'follow' is the closing follow line.
_notes.refs: timbre reference ids for both modes: about 12 s of calm narration, joined with 0.38 s pauses.
_notes.level_db: per-tone speech level of the real recording (dB RMS of the word-aligned speech body, sentences grouped by tone tag), used by assemble.py to set each chunk.
_notes.level_default_db: level for a tone not in level_db.
_notes.f0_window_hz: per-tone range of the sentence-median pitch (f0 field of real_ep1.json, grouped by tone). qcsel accepts a take from 15% below to 10% above the window.
_notes.target_rate_syl_s: mean speaking rate of the real recording (syllables per second over sentences longer than 1.2 s; sd 0.78).
_notes.max_edits: real-recording p90 of vqc.edits (spelling-insensitive edit distance between script and Whisper): 32 of 37 sentences at 0, 5 at 1.
_notes.target_lufs: integrated loudness of the real recording (ffmpeg ebur128).
_notes.centroid_sentence_ids: 10 longer sentences whose speaker embeddings (spans from ep01 timings.json) are averaged into real_centroid.npy.
